gap: No result ChatGPT got that I could read states how much battery the 65% size gives up against the 75% model the labs tested: the NuPhy Air65 V3 is listed at 2,500 mAh, which is 62.5% of the Air75 V3's 4,000 mAh.
standout_why: Compared against keebscout's low-profile guide and mkbguide's low-profile and 65% guides. None gives a battery, weight or hours figure for the Air65 V3, Flow 2 68 or K7 Pro, and none computes days per charge or a 65%-vs-75% battery ratio. mkbguide only quotes Flow 2 84 and Air75 V3 figures. The four RTINGS pages returned only navigation to the fetcher, so I could not check whether they already state the variants' battery sizes. Rated 1, not 2, because the Air65 V3 inputs come from a spec database, not NuPhy's page, and the Flow 2 68 battery inputs could not be opened at all (Shopify returned HTTP 429 on every product-page read).
decides: It does not overturn the pick. It qualifies ChatGPT's top pick: RTINGS's Air75 V3 battery results cannot be carried to the Air65 V3 one-for-one, because the 65% board has a 37.5% smaller cell. The Keychron K7 Pro is the light, cheap row (436 g, $66.49) but lists Bluetooth only and the smallest cell (1,550 mAh). The Lofree Flow 2 68 is the row we can link, at $111.20 in cart. Whether it wins or loses on backlit hours per charge rests on Lofree's own battery figures, which I could not open today.
